facts.claim: index.html loads browserMain.ts as the only browser module entry.

browserMain boots one SimulationCoordinator with the epoch registry, an in-browser telemetry class and an in-memory save repository defined inside browserMain.ts (not the infrastructure NDJSON/file classes).
BrowserSessionTelemetry keeps a capped in-memory array; its compact() is a no-op (void retentionWindowMs).
Per frame, one requestAnimationFrame loop calls session.frame, applies the render frame to the Three scene, and renders once.
PlaySession.frame steps kinematics then runs the round-robin cognitive scheduler pulse every frame, then builds a render frame for the resident stage.
The shipped pack launches with two spaces, one prop and two characters; the cast is a Yard Walker (role_routine) and the Player Operative (utility_schemer).

Nothing at runtime enqueues NPC stimuli: enqueue_npc_stimulus is defined in the effect schema and reducer but no src caller dispatches it, so the cognitive scheduler has nothing to promote in the browser build.

The only src dispatchEffects call sites are inside SimulationCoordinator for move_entity_to_waypoint and update_prop_state; all other effect types (pressure, illicit instrument, discovery, emergency, orbital, legacy scar, audio cue, state slice) are dispatched by nothing in src.
Browser build never calls saveToSlot, loadFromSlot or exportLegacyState; they exist on SimulationCoordinator but have no caller in src outside the coordinator.
The infrastructure layer is imported only by the CLI log query and the Vite dev-server bridge plugin, never by the browser entry.
localDiskBridgePlugin.ts is reachable only from vite.config.ts (dev tooling), not from browserMain or the CLI; src/interfaces/index.ts barrel is also not imported by either entry.

facts.claim: getters for offices, quiet claims, rivals, threads, channels, emergencies and behaviors on EpochModuleRegistry have no callers in src outside the registry; only getOrbitalPass is called (SimulationCoordinator constructor).
Click a button in the on-screen command list to request a move to a waypoint id of the focused entity space (one button per waypoint).
Click a button in the focus list to switch the controlled/camera-focused entity to any entity (including the NPC), via setFocus.
While unpaused, a pointer click on a portal prop cycles its state open -> ajar -> closed -> barred -> open.
While unpaused, a click on the floor moves the focused entity to the nearest authored waypoint within 1.5 m of the click on XZ, else misses silently.
F3 or backquote toggles pause and a de-anchored debug free-cam; while paused, arrow keys move the free-cam by 0.5 m and clicks pick a semantic id for the stage lab inspector.

Keyboard input in the browser is a single keydown listener forwarding to input.keyDown, which handles only F3, backquote and the four arrow keys; there is no WASD, Space, Escape, conversation, menu, interaction, role-pretext or fund verb in src.

facts.claim: A dev-only stage lab panel lets the user edit scene blueprint and character visual JSON and POST it to /api/scene-blueprints/... and /api/character-visuals/... (served by the Vite bridge plugin).
The player Operative is a regular waypoint-mover like any other character: no distinct player-only code path in the domain; focusEntityId is the string char_player_operative passed from browserMain.
EpochModulePackInput supports 11 content kinds: spaces (required), props, characters, offices, quietClaims, rivals, threads, channels, emergencies, a single orbitalPass, and behaviors.
Registry private stores: spaces, props, characters, offices, quietClaims, rivals, threads, channels, emergencies, behaviors maps plus a single orbitalPass.

facts.claim: Content registers exactly: 2 spaces, 1 prop, 2 characters; 0 offices, 0 quiet claims, 0 rivals, 0 threads, 0 channels, 0 emergencies, 0 behaviors, and no orbitalPass. The pack has only spaces, props and characters keys.
Content also ships 2 stage scene blueprints (yard, chambers) and character visuals outside the registry, via STARTER_HOLD_STAGE_DIRECTORY.
With no orbitalPass registered, the coordinator constructor finds undefined from getOrbitalPass, so orbital runtime state is never driven by content in the shipped build.
Offices have a Zod blueprint schema and registry store but no runtime logic or content (fields institutionalLineageId, pretextFamilies, stipendPerTick).
Quiet claims have a blueprint schema and registry store only.

Illicit instruments exist as a 3-value enum and an insert_illicit_instrument effect case in the reducer; pressure stocks exist as a 3-value enum and a PressureStocksState in WorldState; no code outside tests triggers them.
Discovery layers (noticed/assayed/attributed/theorized) are a field on WorldState with a set_discovery_layer effect.
Channels (baseTransitTicks etc.), threads (dualUseCeiling) and rivals (spoof mode enum) have blueprint schemas and registry stores only; no simulation code consumes them.
Emergency states have a blueprint schema, WorldState.activeEmergencyId and three reducer effects (trigger/compound/resolve), with telemetry category mapping, but no content and no trigger caller.
Orbital pass has blueprint, WorldState.orbitalPass runtime state (phase/availableDelta/maxDelta/activeBurn) and advance_orbital_pass/spend_orbital_delta reducer cases.
CivilizationLegacyState (dual material/veil scar ledgers) is implemented as a Zod schema with create/record helpers and wired to the coordinator export/save path.

Conversations, advisors/lace pages, ambient lines, interactionHold, locomotionMode (direct vs waypoint), proximity use, pretext spending, funds, and the eval runner have no type or code in src; the only advisor trace is a telemetry kind string.
